notes.title: v0.9 (Ability Update)
notes.content:
[b] --- Large Changes --- [/b]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[b][*]Abilities:[/b][list]
[*] Players can now gain abilities that heavily change playstyle, allowing for many different build types. There are currently 15 unique abilities to choose from including invisibility, empowered dashes, summoning fly swarms, attack buffs, throwing poison glizzies and many more!
The old [i]skill[/i] has been removed in favour of this system.
[/list]
[b][*]Level Up Rework:[/b][list]
[*] Levelling up now offers 3 different abilities to the Player, allowing them to choose 1. Every 2nd level up (2,4,6 etc.) offers a stat upgrade. You can now upgrade the following stats:
[list]
[*] [b]Health[/b] - Increase health by 5.
[*] [b]Mana[/b] - Increase mana by 10.
[*] [b]Damage[/b] - Increase damage by 10%.
[/list] You can no longer upgrade the [i]special [/i] metre to store multiple charges of a special attack.
[/list]
[b][*]Planet Cores:[/b][list]
[*] You can now travel inside a planet, allowing for even more areas to explore! Additionally, only one Planet will now spawn. Travelling between multiple Planets will be re-enabled in a future patch.
[/list]
[b][*]Planet Generation:[/b][list]
[*] Planets are now more random and should feel much more unique.
[/list]
[b][*]Burrows (Portals):[/b][list]
[*] Springboards are gone! You can now use burrows to travel between the inside/outside of a Planet.
[/list]
[b][*]Platforms:[/b][list]
[*] Platforms are now floating pieces of earth instead of wooden structures. These platforms now spawn at different heights.
[/list]
[b][*]Flight:[/b][list]
[*] Players can now glide for a short period of time (similar to the old Jetpack skill).
[/list]
[b][*]Death Screens:[/b][list]
[*] Dying now displays a nice death animation.
[/list]
[b][*]NPC Spawners:[/b][list]
[*] NPCs now spawn from craters in the ground.
[/list]
[b][*]Starting Weapons:[/b][list]
[*] Players can no longer choose their starting weapon and all Players now start off with a basic wooden sword.
[/list]
[b][*]HP Recovery:[/b][list]
[*] Half of all damage taken now regenerates after not taking damage for 3 seconds (e.g take 80 damage and recover 40 health back over a few seconds).
[/list]
[b][*]Hive Blaster (New Weapon):[/b][list]
[*] A slow weapon that shoots large exploding bee hives, dealing 12 damage. Great for packs of enemies.
[/list]
[b][*]Movement + Camera:[/b][list]
[*] Players now jump slightly higher and run slightly faster. Additionally, the camera has been smoothed out and doesn't look or feel as janky.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Graphics:[/b]
[list]
[b][*]Main Menu:[/b][list]
[*] The main menu has been totally revamped and now supports mouse clicks. The in-game lobby will also be revamped in a future patch.
[/list]
[b][*]Player Model:[/b][list]
[*] The Player model has been improved even further.
[/list]
[b][*]Text/Fonts:[/b][list]
[*] All text/fonts have been improved.
[/list]
[b][*]NPCs:[/b][list]
[*] NPCs are no longer weird monkey things, they are now Snails!
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Steam API bug that would sometimes not let the Player connect to the same host again unless they restarted their game.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8.1
notes.content:
[b] --- Large Changes --- [/b][list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[b][*]Slide Attack (New Dodge Mechanic):[/b][list]
[*] Players now slide when dodging. Sliding into an enemy knocks them up and inflicts a small amount of damage. Players will still avoid damage whiling dodging.
[/list]
[b][*]New Weapon (Flag Lance):[/b][list]
[*] [b]Attack[/b] - A slow strong attack. Inflicts 16 damage.
[*] [b]Special[/b] - Leap upwards and slam down, stunning all enemies for 1.5 seconds and causing 20 damage.
[/list]
[b][*]Attack Knockback:[/b][list]
[*] Melee weapons now slowdown and/or knockback other Players.
[/list]
[b][*]HP Recovery:[/b][list]
[*] Health will now regenerate after not taking damage for 10 seconds (based on damage taken + damage dealt).
[/list]
[b][*]Damage Text + Graphical Update:[/b][list]
[*] All in-game text displays (damage numbers, dodge alert etc.) have been updated and should look clearer.
[*] All objects + blocks have been updated to better match the new Player model.
[/list][/list][/list]
[b] --- Small Changes --- [/b][list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] All Weapons appearances have been slightly upgraded.
[*] All NPC appearances have been slightly upgraded.
[*] The "Stone Launcher" and "Wooden Blade" weapon appearances have been upgraded.
[*] "Stone Launcher" damage increased (9 -> 12).
[*] "Stone Launcher" mana increased (25 -> 35).
[*] Bots are now easier and more fair (slower reactions, attack/dodge less etc.).
[*] "Mace Weapon" attack range has been slightly lowered.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Steam API bug that was causing memory leaks after longer Multiplayer games. 
[/list][/list]

notes.title: v0.7
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[b] --- Large Changes --- [/b][list]
[b][*] New Map Type (Underground):[/b][list]
[*] Maps can now spawn with an Underground-like formation instead of the traditional Planet formation. [*] Underground formations have a 1/3 chance of appearing.
[/list]
[b][*] Kill Feed:[/b][list]
[*] Player kills & deaths are now announced to all Players on screen.
[/list]
[b][*] Graphical Update:[/b][list]
[*] Backgrounds have been heavily reworked.
[*] Tilesets have also been updated.
[/list]
[b][*] HUD Update:[/b][list]
[*] Players can now see their kills & deaths during gameplay.
[*] Player stats now appear in the top left corner and have been cleaned up.
[*] Stats of other Players can now only be seen while viewing the big map.
[*] When a level up is available, the Player will have a notification above their character until they level up. This change aims to make leveling up more obvious.
[*] Game related stats such as coins & time now show on the top of the screen rather than under the minimap.
[/list][/list]

[b] --- Small Changes --- [/b][list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] Snake Whip poison tick damage increased (1 -> 2).
[*] Weapons drop faster when created and don't spawn as high.
[*] Weapon spawns are now permanently outlined.
[*] Lobby background is now random rather than a static black background.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Players wouldn't get XP from poison damage.
[*] Fixed bug where Battery Storm Cloud kills wouldn't count.
[*] Fixed bug where controller d-pad wasn't working correctly on the main menu.
[*] Fixed bug where pressing the Skill button with the Jetpack would consume a charge but do nothing.
[*] Fixed bug where killing blows on Players would not show the damage dealt.
[/list][/list]

notes.title: v0.6
notes.content:
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] W + S can now be used to navigate the main menu. E can now be used to select options on the main menu.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[b] --- Large Changes --- [/b][list]
[*] [b] Rework to "Special" stat :[/b][list]
[*] Now displayed as "charges" instead of a bar. Using "Special" consumes 1 charge.
[*] "Special" now regenerates about 25% faster.
[*] Consuming a "Special" charge now has a nice particle effect.
[*] Skills now only consume a single charge and last around 5 seconds.
[/list]
[b][*] Level Up Stats:[/b][list]
[*] HP (Green): 5 -> 10.
[*] Mana (Blue): 10 -> 20.
[*] Special (Red): 12 -> 1/4 of a charge (or 25%).
[/list]
[b][*] HUD Update:[/b][list]
[*] Players can now see their selected Skill on their bar.
[*] Players can now see their "red/grey" HP on the main Health bar.
[*] Weapon list has been simplified.
[/list]
[b][*] Battery Weapon Rework:[/b][list]
[*] Battery Mana cost (33 -> 30).
[*] Battery no longer slows the user when attacking.
[*] Storm will now attack consistently when enemies are nearby (both Players + NPCs).
[*] Damage caused by the Storm will now grant the caster XP.
[*] Friendly clouds will now appear white-ish. Enemy clouds now have a black-ish, thunderstorm appearance.
[*] Bots can now start off with the Battery.
[/list]
[b][*] NPC XP Changes:[/b][list]
[*] NPCs now give about 50% less XP from attacks.
[*] NPCs now drop an "XP" reward on death. The higher the NPC's Max HP, the higher the XP given.
[*] This should overall be an XP buff from NPCs. The aim of this change is to make killing NPCs feel more rewarding.
[/list][/list]
[b] --- Small Changes --- [/b]
[list]
[*] Wooden Blade mana cost (35 -> 30).
[*] Wooden Blaster mana cost (30 -> 25).
[*] Weapon limit decreased from (5 -> 3). 
[*] Coins to reward weapon reverted back to 20 (down from 25).
[*] Level ups now require around 25% extra XP. Level ups will now happen less often but have a larger impact.
[*] Minimap now displays planet graphics (Grasslands, Snowlands, Firelands etc.) instead of simple grey blocks.
[*] Text now appears when spectating another Player.
[*] Names now appear above Players.
[*] Attack/Death particles have been improved.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where multiple layers of Lava would be created when Sudden Death starts.
[*] Fixed bug where clients could occasionally not level up.
[*] Fixed bug where lobby would sometimes not be visible in the search.
[*] Fixed bug where certain Customisation options weren't properly changing colour.
[*] Fixed bug where certain weapons were incorrectly displaying (clipping through Player's head).
[*] Fixed bug where clients could occasionally desync from the host at the end of a round.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.5.1
notes.content:
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now view the controls (Keyboard + Controller) in the Main Menu or Pause Menu. The controls are now as follows:

[b] Keyboard [/b]
- [b]W,A,S,D[/b] - Move/Jump
- [b]E[/b] - Interact
- [b]1, 2[/b] - Swap Weapons
- [b]Space[/b] - Attack
- [b]R[/b] - Special Attack
- [b]Q[/b] - Skill
- [b]Shift[/b] - Dodge
- [b]C[/b] - Level Up
- [b]Tab[/b] - Map
- [b]Esc[/b] - Menu

[b] Controller (Xbox) [/b]
- [b]L-Stick[/b] - Move
- [b]A[/b] - Jump
- [b]Y[/b] - Interact
- [b]LB, RB[/b] - Swap Weapons
- [b]RT[/b] - Attack
- [b]B[/b] - Special Attack
- [b]X[/b] - Skill
- [b]LT[/b] - Dodge
- [b]D-Pad (R)[/b] - Level Up
- [b]Select[/b] - Map
- [b]Start[/b] - Menu
Note: Non-Xbox Controllers should work but currently, the button design is relative to Xbox Controller layout (EG: A to Jump (Xbox) -> X to Jump (PlayStation) etc.)
[*] Main Menu now has new icons and slightly new design. 
[/list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] Interactables (Chests, Weapons, Springboards) now show a button prompt when in use range.
[*] Maps are more condensed and smaller. This should make games faster pace and less confusing to navigate around.
[*] Undiscovered Planets now appear greyed out, rather than not appearing at all. 
[*] Players can now swap Planets by touching a block from another Planet! (through Jetpacking etc.)
[*] Deathmatch Timer: 150 -> 100.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed client issue where NPCs would be created oddly, resulting in the game slowing down.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.5
notes.content:
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Player animation improvements.
[*] Space bar can now be used to select an option on the main menu.
[*] W,A,S,D can now be used to navigate the main menu.
[*] Lobby layout has been reworked and improved.
[*] Lobby transitions/fading improvements.
[*] "Level Up" text now appears at the bottom of the screen.
[*] Game will now automatically refresh available lobbies when "Join Lobby" is clicked. Before, Players had to manually click "Refresh" each time.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[b] --- Large Changes --- [/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added Skills:[/b]
  Players can now choose a Skill in the Customisation menu. Skills temporarily provide powerful utility and the duration of Skills scale with the Player's special metre.
3 new Skills added are:
[list]
[*] [b]Jetpack[/b]- Hover for short periods of time.
[*] [b]Stealth[/b] - Turn invisible, causing others to be unable to see you. Attacking while invisible temporarily reveals the Player.
[*] [b]Harden[/b]- Harden the bug's shell, reducing damage taken by around 40%.
[/list] 
[*] [b]Starter Weapons:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can now select a starting weapon in the Customisation screen. Players no longer start with the default wooden weapons.
[*] Players can also see the stats of their selected weapon in the Customisation screen.
[/list] 
[*] [b]Map Rework:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bigmap/minimap now only show the Planets the Player has visited.
[/list] 
[*] [b]Updated HUD/UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Player's own stats are now displayed at the bottom of the screen.
[*] Other Player's stats are now easier to see and don't bloat the screen as much.
[*] Screen will now flash red when taking damage.
[/list] 
[*] [b]Attack Feedback:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players + NPCs will now visibly react to being damaged.
[*] Attacks now have hit particles and audio (credit to [url=https://twitter.com/untiedgames]@untiedgames[/url] for some of the particles!)
[*]  Screen will now flash red when taking damage.
[/list] 
[*] [b]New NPCs:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Flying Apes[/b]- These enemies hover around the Player and periodically fly down to strike the Player. They are fast and hard to hit but have very low HP.
[/list] 
[*] [b]Reward Bags:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bags can now be found on platforms near NPCs.
[*] Attacking bags will destroy them, granting the Players coins or a stat increase! (HP, Mana, Special, XP)
[/list] 
[*] [b]Removed Forced Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players are no longer forced to fight NPCs and/or Players at camps.
[/list] 
[/list]
[b] --- Small Changes --- [/b]
[list]
[*] Planet generation is now more random, smaller and generate more platforms (Wider variety of maps).
[*] NPCs coin drops: 3 -> 2.
[*] Coins no longer obey gravity.
[*] Coins to create weapon: 20 -> 25.
[*] Grasslands background has been updated.
[*] Damage numbers should now be clearer.
[*] Chest are now displayed in front of Platforms.
[*] Mace Weapon Special now has a large explosion hitbox.
[*] Wooden Blaster damage: 8 -> 9.
[*] Wooden Blade damage: 9 -> 10.
[*] Ammo has been doubled for most weapons (100%-ish more ammo for all weapons).
[*] Time limit in Deathmatch increased: 120 -> 150.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where camps were sometimes appearing as cleared even when they weren't.
[*] Fixed issue where clients sometimes couldn't see the winner at the end of a round.
[*] Fixed issue where clients stats would sometimes not be updated after leveling up.
[*] Fixed issue where increasing Max HP would appear like the Player has taken damage.
[*] Fixed issue where clients couldn't properly see their latency to the host.
[*] Fixed issue where deaths were sometimes not being updated to the Leaderboards.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.4
notes.content:
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Leaderboards[/b]!
The following stats are now tracked:
[list]
[*] Kills
[*] Deaths
[*] Experience
[*] Coins
[*] Chests
[*] Matches Played
[*] Matches Won
[/list] These stats can be viewed in the Main Menu and will be updated at the end of every match played.
Players can see how they rank against other Players close to their rank or against the Top 10 scores.

[*] Lobby improvements and layout adjustments.
[*] Non-server Players can now see what option is being selected in the lobby.
[*] Players can now join lobbies, refresh lobby lists and change region search through keyboard/controller controls (previous was only left clicking).
[/list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Teams![/b]
The Host can now enable [b]Teams[/b] and assign Players to the Blue/Red/Green/Yellow team. All gamemodes support Teams.
[*] [b] Terrains![/b]
Added 2 new planet terrain types (Snow + Fire) which each have a 1/3 chance of appearing. Terrains affect how a Planet is generated.
[*] [b]Puddle Hazards![/b]
Certain planet terrains will have small hazardous patches scattered around the planet. New [b]Puddle[/b] hazards are:
[list]
[*] Ice Patch (Snow Planet) - Stepping on these will make movement slower and slippy. 
[*] Lava Patch (Fire Planet) - Stepping on these will deal damage and blast the Player upwards.
[/list] [*] [b]Terrain Weapons![/b]
Certain weapons are now only obtainable depending on the terrain type:
[list]
[*] Snake Whip- (Grass Planet)
[*] Ice Bomb- (Snow Planet)
[*] Fire Blaster- (Fire Planet) [/list] [*] NPCs now have weapons based on the terrain type.
[*] NPCs colour will now change with terrain type.[/list]
[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ice Bomb[/b] - Now only throws slightly in front of the Player. Previously, it lobbed very far ahead and was hard to land.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fade transitions should now correctly hide objects.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.3
notes.content:
[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Level Up Bonus (Mana): 8 -> 10.
[*] Level Up Bonus (Special): 12 -> 10.
[*] "Boxing Glove" stun: 2.5 seconds -> 2.0 seconds.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Gamemode "[b]Star Hunt[/b]". Players compete to collect a Star that randomly appears around the map. The first Player to collect "Score to Win" Stars wins!
[*] Added new "Big Ape" NPC.
[*] NPCs can now spawn with different weapons and with slightly different colours.
[*] Big map now fits on screen better.
[*] Player/NPC death animation improvements.
[/list]
[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Host can now change "Gamemode" and "Score to Win" settings in the Lobby.
[*] Lobby layout improvements.
[*] Added a minimum 2 Player/Bot requirement to start game.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed rare crash when spectating a Player that leaves.
[*] Fixed some graphical issues related to dead Players.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - v0.2
notes.content:
- Added Bots (Host can add bots in the pre-game Lobby).
- Added Sudden Death event.
- Misc adjustments and improvements.
